channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Patrick Reed leaving LIV Golf, cleared for eventual return to PGA Tour
item.description: Reed, a nine-time winner on Tour and 2018 Masters champion, announced Wednesday that he will compete full-time on the DP World Tour this season before rejoining the PGA Tour as a past champion in 2027.

item.title: Farmers Insurance Open 2026: Odds, favorites for Torrey Pines
item.description: Xander Schauffele enters his first PGA Tour event of 2026 as the favorite. Will rest and a hometown advantage be enough to carry the No. 6-ranked player in the world to his first-ever win at Torrey Pines?

item.title: Patrick Reed sets sight on PGA Tour return
item.description: Ryan Lavner joins Golf Today to react to breaking news that Patrick Reed intends to return to the PGA Tour. Here's what the move means to the golf world and when fans can expect to see Reed again.

item.title: Patrick Reed is good for PGA competition: McGinley
item.description: Paul McGinley joins Golf Today to discuss what Patrick Reed's decision to return to the PGA Tour means for other LIV players and what's Reed path back looks like.

item.title: Korn Ferry Tour pro Brendan Valdes sidelined after cancer diagnosis
item.description: Valdes, who was entering his first full season on the Korn Ferry Tour, was recently diagnosed with primary mediastinal lymphoma and will take an indefinite leave from professional golf.

item.title: LIV changes include more money for teams and 10 more spots to secure status
item.description: LIV Golf will be awarding points to every player in the field and expanding to 34 the number of players who secure status.

item.title: World No. 1 Jeeno Thitikul feeling 100% entering TOC debut
item.description: Thitikul is teeing it up at the Hilton Grand Vacations Tournament of Champions for the first time this week, and she does so with her left wrist feeling 100%.

item.title: Bad day for LIV, great day for PGA: Chamblee on Reed news
item.description: Brandel Chamblee believes Patrick Reed's return to the PGA Tour gives the tour a polarizing figure who will help generate significant rivalries and increase its entertainment value. Chamblee sees Reeds desire to play in tournaments with "historic weight" as a positive for the PGA Tour and bad news for LIV.

item.title: Ahead of opener, LPGA stars weigh in on WTGL
item.description: The 2026 LPGA season begins this week at the Hilton Grand Vacations Tournament of Champions. Some of the tour's best, including Nelly Korda, Jeeno Thitikul and Charley Hull weigh in on the new WTGL and if women should have been included in TGL.

item.title: PGA Tour sends clear message with Patrick Reed’s return
item.description: A quick survey of the landscape would suggest the Tour reacted quickly to an opportunity in bringing Reed back to the fold, although his return will be delayed seven months. But the truth is Reed’s return had been in the works for some time, much like Koepka’s.
